n = int(input())
tong = 0
while True:
    if n == 0:
        break
    tong += n
    n -= 1
print(tong)
print("NO" if (n := int(input())) < 2 or any(n % d == 0 for d in range(2, n)) else "YES")

uoc = 0

        uoc += 1

from functools import reduce
n = int(input())
gt = reduce(lambda a, b: a * b, range(1, n + 1), 1)
print(gt)
